name: Cervical Foraminal Stenosis
definition: Narrowing of a cervical neural foramen due to uncovertebral/facet hypertrophy, disc-height loss or disc material, becoming clinically important when it correlates with nerve-root symptoms.

redFlags.item: Trauma, infection or malignancy red flags

investigations.principle: Clinical-radiological correlation is essential because foraminal narrowing can be asymptomatic.
investigations.MRI: MRI demonstrates neural structures; CT better defines bony foraminal narrowing when needed.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may suggest degenerative narrowing but are not sufficient for root assessment.

green: Education, graded activity and cervical/scapular rehabilitation
amber: Persistent disabling radiculopathy or progressive deficit may require specialist injection or surgical consideration.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva-region Vata phenotype may be documented only as a parallel correlation.

patientEducation.summary: Narrowing of a cervical neural foramen due to uncovertebral/facet hypertrophy, disc-height loss or disc material, becoming clinically important when it correlates with nerve-root symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Cervical Neck Pain or Cervical Radiculopathy
